title.zh: AWS宣布Mechanical Turk将停止接受新客户并进入维护状态，未来或将退役
title.en: AWS says Mechanical Turk will no longer accept new customers and that it is placing the crowdsourcing service in maintenance, signaling its future retirement

title.zh: 美光启动约93亿美元广岛工厂扩建计划，计划2028年夏季开始HBM出货
title.en: Micron breaks ground on its ~$9.3B Hiroshima factory expansion, part of its global ramp-up to meet AI demand, and plans to start HBM shipments from summer 2028

title.zh: 高收入家庭如何利用AI驱动的私立学校和导师教授生活技能并定制课程
title.en: How some high-income families use AI-powered private schools and tutors, such as Alpha School, to teach their children life skills and tailor their curriculum

title.zh: 字节跳动通过Seedance视频生成器进军好莱坞，凭借低价、逼真效果和时间轴提示功能
title.en: How ByteDance is making Hollywood inroads with its Seedance video generator, thanks to low pricing, striking realism, and features like timeline-based prompting

title.zh: 中国拟定拟人化AI交互规则，字节跳动的豆包和阿里巴巴的Qwen将于7月15日前禁用类人和用户创建的代理
title.en: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen will disable humanlike and user-created agents before July 15, as China's anthropomorphic AI interaction rules take effect

title.zh: Google DeepMind哲学家Iason Gabriel的个人档案，其研究预测了LLM成功带来的伦理挑战
title.en: A profile of Google DeepMind philosopher Iason Gabriel, whose work has tracked, and in many cases predicted, the ethical challenges posed by the success of LLMs

title.zh: 苹果芯片高级产品经理Doug Brooks访谈：Mac mini为何成为AI代理首选设备及设备端AI的未来
title.en: Q&A with Doug Brooks, senior product manager of Apple silicon, about Mac minis becoming preferred AI agent machines, future of on-device AI, and more

title.zh: 新加坡dConstruct Robotics完成1.25亿美元A轮融资，开发复杂环境下自主机器人空间技术
title.en: Singapore-based dConstruct Robotics, which develops spatial tech to let autonomous robots operate in complex, GPS-denied environments, raised a $125M Series A

title.zh: 总部位于纽约的LinqAlpha完成2200万美元A轮融资，提供对冲基金AI驱动的市场研究工具
title.en: NY-based LinqAlpha, which provides AI-powered market research tools for hedge funds, raised a $22M Series A co-led by AVP, Atinum Investment, and GFT Ventures

title.zh: 总部位于布拉格的EquiLibre完成5亿美元估值的A轮融资，专注于量化对冲基金的AI解决方案
title.en: Prague-based EquiLibre, which offers AI for quant hedge funds and is founded by three ex-Google DeepMind researchers, raised a Series A at a $500M valuation

title.zh: 特斯拉在迈阿密推出无安全员的Robotaxi服务
title.en: Tesla rolls out its Robotaxi service without a safety monitor in Miami, its fifth city, as it aims to expand to a dozen US states by the end of 2026

summary.zh: 这是特斯拉在美国的第五个城市，计划到2026年底扩展至12个州。
